metadata.description: Wire format for `GET /v1/admin/status`: process identity, catalog counts and live telemetry. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/admin.rs` (`Status`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/admin_status_response/`. Unbounded telemetry counters use canonical decimal strings; structurally bounded catalog counts use uint32 checked at the wire boundary.
The registry name held by the in-memory index.
The registry source URL held by the in-memory index.
The generator identity copied from the index at server boot.
Whole seconds since server startup, encoded as a canonical decimal u64 string: ASCII digits only, no sign, no leading zeros except `0`.
Whether mutation routes are disabled for this process.
How many `(group, name)` packages the index holds, including packages whose versions this build quarantines. Bounded by construction and checked at the wire boundary.
How many versions the index holds, including quarantined versions. Bounded by construction and checked at the wire boundary.
Requests observed by this process, including the status request itself, encoded as a canonical decimal u64 string: ASCII digits only, no sign, no leading zeros except `0`.
State-changing mutations completed by this process, encoded as a canonical decimal u64 string: ASCII digits only, no sign, no leading zeros except `0`.
